Average lunch, good view
Sep 2024 • Friends

It was very busy with locals, and im sure the view on a sunny day would be spectacular.
Service was slow but the staff friendly. The portion sizes are huge, we ordered sandwiches which came with salad fries.
The tuna mayo filling was super tasty, however my husbands chcoek and avocado salad lacked flavour and was very watery.
Overall not bad prices considering the location and what could easily have been a tourist trap.

Great food, friendly staff
Oct 2019 • Couples
The first days we were on the island the restaurant was closed. We had dinner there the night it re-opened, and we were glad we came back.
We had a green mango salad, a stir fry beef noodle and a small combo of seafood. Everything was really tasty, and especially the seafood was amazing. The price was very reasonable, and when the waiter accidentally charged a bit too much (without us noticing) they chased us down the street to apologize. So sincere. 
Would without a doubt recommend it.
